facilitator_note.en:
Note: The selection of poems to be analyzed will be ﬂexible according to the discussions in every class.

Course work: Throughout the course, participants will be expected to start working on their own individual works of art (poems, digital art, paintings, photography..etc) in order to be collected and compiled in a digital anthology by the end of the course.
